objective: Test a query-verified addressed RWKV hybrid that applies recurrent modulation only when the projected-KV router and RWKV's independent query-to-state router agree beyond chance.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: The addressed affine recurrent read changed native outputs but was worse than projected-only, zero, matched-donor, and layer-permuted controls on the locked 220-row open development generation endpoint.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Retain projected addressing for the recurrent value read, independently compute RWKV's own query-driven route, and abstain unless the two route distributions agree beyond uniform chance.

architecture.addressing: The projected key/value slot route selects the corresponding recurrent RWKV state slots; an independent RWKV query-to-state route is computed from the same state and token query.
architecture.fusion_equation: projected_read * (1 + 0.125 * agreement * direction), where direction = tanh(projected_addressed_recurrent_read / rms(projected_addressed_recurrent_read))
architecture.recurrent_role: bounded elementwise controller gated by agreement between two independently query-driven state routes
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: A zero recurrent state produces zero direction, so fusion is exactly projected-only.
architecture.chance_overlap_identity: A uniform-overlap route pair produces zero agreement, so fusion is exactly projected-only.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.correct_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus addressed recurrent readout gated by independent RWKV route agreement.
causal_conditions.zero_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus zero recurrent state.
causal_conditions.matched_donor_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus a deterministic different-gold, length-matched donor recurrent state; agreement is recomputed for the donor state.
causal_conditions.layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct-row projected carrier plus correct recurrence cyclically moved across all 42 wrapped layers; agreement is recomputed.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient or optimizer update

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize only a separately locked causal training run for this route-agreement equation with a new source/donor-disjoint open endpoint.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the structural failure and move to a supervised query/state retrieval hybrid without native generation testing this equation.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, or the unused strength holdout.

claim_policy.pass: May claim only BF16-visible structural sensitivity to recurrent row and layer under query-verified route agreement before training.
claim_policy.native_gain: Forbidden without later held-out causal preference and a separately locked native generation result.
